plugins.name: ltx2-vidgen
plugins.description: Drop a photo in Claude Code and get a video. Self-hosted LTX-2.3 (22B): text-to-video, image-to-video, keyframe interpolation, video-to-video, and IC-LoRA canny/depth/pose control, with synced audio. Deploys to your own Modal serverless GPU — a few cents a clip, no per-clip meter.
